key_insight: OmniCapBench proposes a deeper, more structured way to evaluate audio-visual captioning in multimodal LLMs, aiming to reveal fine-grained strengths and failure modes that coarse scores miss. It bridges the gap between broad coverage and precise localization in evaluation.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of reliable benchmarks for fine-grained audio-visual captioning. Existing methods either score whole captions without telling where errors occur, probe local details without broader coverage, or depend on unstable LLM-based judges.
method: Introduces a deep-structured evaluation framework for audio-visual captioning tasks.
Combines broad caption-level assessment with localized diagnostic probes to better pinpoint model weaknesses.
Seeks to reduce instability from unconstrained LLM judging by making evaluation more structured and consistent.
impact: This matters because practitioners need evaluations that do more than rank models—they need tools that diagnose why models fail and where. OmniCapBench can help researchers compare MLLMs more fairly and improve them more systematically.
